title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Arbitration Law of the People's Republic of China
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Arbitration Law of the People's Republic of China

Fa Fa [1997] No. 4

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government:

In order to clarify several issues that need to be addressed by the people's courts in implementing the Arbitration Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the "Arbitration Law"), notice is hereby given as follows:

1. Arbitration agreements lawfully concluded by the parties before the implementation of the Arbitration Law shall remain effective. If a relevant party initiates a lawsuit with a people's court, the people's court shall not entertain the case and shall inform the party to apply for arbitration to an arbitration institution established in accordance with the Arbitration Law. After the parties have agreed in writing to waive arbitration, if one party initiates a lawsuit with a people's court, the people's court shall entertain the case in accordance with law.

2. During the arbitration process, where a party applies for property preservation, in ordinary cases, the basic people's court at the place of domicile of the respondent or at the place where the property is located shall render a ruling. In cases involving foreign-related arbitration, a ruling shall be rendered by the intermediate people's court at the place of domicile of the respondent or at the place where the property is located, in accordance with Article 258 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China. The relevant people's court shall carefully examine the application for property preservation submitted by the arbitration institution. If it complies with legal provisions, it shall promptly render a ruling on property preservation in accordance with law. If it is deemed not to comply with legal provisions, the application shall be rejected by a ruling in accordance with law.

3. Where a party applies for enforcement of an arbitral award (including a foreign-related arbitral award) rendered by an arbitration institution established in accordance with the Arbitration Law, the people's court shall entertain the case in accordance with law.

March 26, 1997
